headings.usage: Dashboard titles, metric numbers, and major section headers.

body.usage: General text, table data, forms, AI explanations, and tooltips.

colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy meets Swiss High-Contrast (Clean Business)
rules: Avoid excessive colors. Use brand green/blue sparingly to highlight key actions or positive metrics.
Tinted Grey Rule: All greys (slate/zinc) must have a subtle blue/green undertone, never pure #808080.
NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for overlapping content (e.g., dropdowns, sticky headers). Always use solid backgrounds or backdrop blurs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid Minimalist. Flat solid backgrounds for data clarity with subtle 1px border. NO Glassmorphism on data-heavy widgets.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows. hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200 for interactive cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 (light) or border-slate-700 (dark). Use border-radius: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for inner elements.

layouts.app_shell: Sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile) + Top header + Main content area.
layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B (High Density Grid): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use col-span-2 or col-span-3 for large charts (P&L, Cash Flow), and col-span-1 for summary KPIs.
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for cards: p-6 or p-8.
layouts.alignment: Left-align text and numbers for better readability. Center-align only empty states or specific AI conversation bubbles.

components.kpi_cards: Flat rectangular cards. Metric value in Cabinet Grotesk. Status indicator (Green/Yellow/Red) with a small trend arrow. Must include an 'Info' icon (Phosphor) that triggers a tooltip explaining 'What is this?'.
components.charts: Recharts wrapped in Shadcn. Line charts for Cash Flow, Bar charts for P&L. Use the designated Soft Green and Soft Blue.
components.ai_chat: Floating panel or distinct right-sidebar. AI bubbles should have a soft secondary background (e.g., bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20). Must support structured markdown responses.
components.tables: Dense, exact alignments (right-align currency). Sticky headers. Hover states on rows.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with crisp hover state (slightly darker background, not transparent).
components.forms: Shadcn form inputs (.js/.jsx format). Clear labels, inline validation.
components.gauges: Custom SVG or Recharts radial bar for 'Financial Health Score' and 'Data Quality Score'.

motion.transitions: Specific property transitions (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors duration-200). DO NOT use transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets (Framer Motion).
motion.interactions: Hover scaling on buttons. Tooltips fade in quickly. Accordions for AI explanations.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). Best for dense dashboards. Fallback to lucide-react if needed.

image_urls.description: Professional AC technician working. Use in the onboarding wizard or as a hero image for the initial company setup screen.
Abstract business finance charts. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background for the Login/Register screens.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use dark charcoal (#1A1D1A) on white backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-csv-button').
accessibility.language: UI text in Indonesian mixed with English accounting terms (e.g., 'Laba Bersih (Net Profit)'). AI explanations in plain, non-jargon Indonesian.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react recharts framer-motion lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge
Configure Tailwind with the specified colors and Cabinet Grotesk / IBM Plex Sans font families.
Build the dashboard using a CSS Grid layout (gap-6). Do not rely on flex wrap for the main widget grid.
Implement a 'What is this?' tooltip/popover for all advanced financial metrics (Net Margin, Receivables, etc.) using Shadcn HoverCard or Tooltip components.
For the Ask Finance AI interface, ensure it handles structured responses (summary, metrics, findings, risks, recommendations, confidence, sources) beautifully using cards and lists.
Do not use the standard `App.css` center alignment. Text should naturally flow left.
Ensure the Excel/CSV file upload uses a wizard UI (Shadcn Stepper or similar) for column mapping.
All React code should be in .js or .jsx format, NOT .tsx.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid Glassmorphism on data tables to maintain legibility.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md or pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use actual SVG Icons instead.
Provide clear, conversational Indonesian text for the AI analysis components.
